# Design point P002

## Description

Clients use incremental bounded pack repacking to keep local repository maintenance costs controlled as data grows. The repositories themselves are distributed through the filesystem layer across application instances, preserving existing Rails and Git internals; these choices address different scaling concerns and are compatible.
